comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-item-list.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1492, mitcad#1750): a 60 x 40 x 20 box (F2.b0) from Sketch1 (F1); Sketch2 (F3) on its top face, empty, for the steps to draw in; Sketch3 (F4) on XY as a design saved before the work steps were recorded has it: a line, its two points and an inactive Horizontal on the line (k4, met by the line: a dimmed cell with no badge, mitcad#1763), no steps.
